task_description: Write a method in Dafny to check if given sequence contains no duplicates.
specification_response:
Method Signature:
    method NoDuplicates(seq: seq<int>) returns (result: bool)
Postconditions_prompt:
    - If the method returns true, then no element appears more than once in the sequence
- If the method returns false, then there exists at least one element that appears multiple times in the sequence
